2607.23678.title: Focus Is All You Need: Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration for Multi-Agent Graph Systems
2607.23678.paper_summary: Large language models (LLMs) enable autonomous agents for reasoning, planning, and tool use. Recent systems increasingly organize these agents as graphs of specialized, interconnected nodes. Although graph-based orchestration supports flexible decomposition and coordination, it creates a key challenge: \textbf{attention allocation}. As workflows grow, existing approaches often execute graph components uniformly, wasting resources on irrelevant or low-impact tasks. We introduce \textbf{Attention Orchestration}, a paradigm that extends Transformer-style attention from token representations to workflow-level agent coordination. Our framework, \textbf{Adaptive Goal-aware Attention Orchestration (AGAO)}, dynamically estimates agent importance based on user objectives, graph dependencies, and computational constraints. AGAO combines three components: (1) goal-aware attention, measuring semantic relevance between user goals and agent capabilities; (2) topology-aware attention, modeling structural dependencies in agent graphs; and (3) resource-aware attention, allocating budgets and execution priorities across heterogeneous agents. Together, these mechanisms transform static agent graphs into adaptive systems that focus computation on goal-critical reasoning paths. Experiments across diverse multi-agent workloads show that AGAO improves task effectiveness while reducing unnecessary computation, latency, and token consumption compared with existing graph-based execution strategies. Our work establishes \textbf{Attention Engineering} as a direction for scalable, intelligent multi-agent systems. Code: https://github.com/MingzhouFan97/AGAO.
2607.23678.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）使自主代理能夠進行推理、規劃和工具使用。最近的系統越來越多地將這些代理組織為專門的、相互連接的節點圖。儘管基於圖的協調支持靈活的分解和協調，但它帶來了一個關鍵挑戰：\textbf{注意力分配}。隨著工作流程的增長，現有方法通常均勻執行圖組件，浪費資源在不相關或影響較小的任務上。我們引入了\textbf{注意力協調}，這是一種將Transformer風格的注意力從標記表示擴展到工作流程級別的代理協調的範式。我們的框架\textbf{自適應目標感知注意力協調（AGAO）}，根據用戶目標、圖依賴性和計算約束動態估計代理的重要性。AGAO結合了三個組件：（1）目標感知注意力，測量用戶目標與代理能力之間的語義相關性；（2）拓撲感知注意力，建模代理圖中的結構依賴性；以及（3）資源感知注意力，在異構代理之間分配預算和執行優先級。這些機制共同將靜態代理圖轉變為自適應系統，專注於目標關鍵的推理路徑。針對多樣化的多代理工作負載的實驗顯示，AGAO在提高任務有效性的同時，減少了不必要的計算、延遲和標記消耗，與現有的基於圖的執行策略相比。我們的工作確立了\textbf{注意力工程}作為可擴展、智能多代理系統的一個方向。代碼：https://github.com/MingzhouFan97/AGAO。
